create.name: Tara Institute
create.bio:
Tara Institute is a Tibetan Buddhist centre for study and meditation in Brighton East, a bayside suburb in Melbourne's south-east. It is part of the FPMT network founded by Lama Thubten Yeshe and Lama Zopa Rinpoche, teaches in the tradition of Lama Tsongkhapa and follows the guidance of the Dalai Lama. Venerable Geshe Doga has been its resident teacher since 1984, and Geshe Lobsang Dorjee now teaches there too. Some of the residents are ordained, and the house also holds a library, a dining room and a well-stocked bookshop.

Classes are not charged for, and the centre runs on membership, donations and volunteers. Monday evenings bring an informal introduction to Buddhist philosophy and meditation led by senior students, with a talk, guided meditation and discussion; on Wednesday nights Geshe Lobsang teaches Shantideva's Guide to the Bodhisattva's Way of Life, and a short Wednesday morning meditation works through a twelve-week cycle from the breath to the nature of reality. A Tuesday study group, a monthly Dharma club for children aged four to fifteen and a programme for school groups complete the week. For thirty years volunteers have transcribed the evening teachings, and many Monday classes can be watched on the institute's YouTube channel.

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Yearly or monthly membership that keeps the centre's free classes running, with a welcome pack, a bookshop discount, library membership, access to Tara Institute TV and dedications in the centre's pujas.

courses.title: Teaching Transcripts Subscription
courses.description: An annual subscription to emailed transcripts of the Tuesday or Wednesday evening teachings by Geshe Doga and Geshe Lobsang, prepared each week by volunteer teams, which also funds the centre's printed archive and new books.
courses.price: Take an annual $40 single subscription (both nights $70)

free_resources.title: Monday Nights: Buddhist philosophy and meditation
free_resources.description: An informal Monday evening for everyone, led by a senior student, combining guided meditation, a talk and group discussion on a monthly theme; no booking, with a small optional facility contribution.

free_resources.title: Wednesday Nights with Geshe Lobsang Dorjee
free_resources.description: Weekly evening teachings by the resident geshe on Shantideva's Guide to the Bodhisattva's Way of Life; no registration, just come along.

free_resources.title: Wednesday 11am Meditations
free_resources.description: A half-hour morning meditation for beginners and experienced meditators, following a twelve-week cycle from mindfulness of breathing and of the body through impermanence, loving kindness and compassion to the nature of reality.

free_resources.title: Self Study Education Programme
free_resources.description: Self-paced study of classic Indian and Tibetan Buddhist texts taught by Geshe Doga, such as Liberation in the Palm of Your Hand, using transcripts, discussion points and exams, with help from senior students on request.
